    SCOTLAND

    This special Scotch is a limited edition collaboration with the actor Willem Dafoe. Dafoe worked directly with Senior Whisky Blender Sarah Dowling to select the final cut. Initially matured in American oak ex-Bourbon casks, then finished in hand-selected Oloroso Sherry casks, it perfectly blends Laphroaig’s coastal heritage with a rich, cinematic complexity.

    The distillery is perched on the shore of the island of Islay, exposed to all the elements the Hebridean Sea can throw at it, and the rich peatland they’ve been infusing into their whisky for over 200 years is right beside it. It’s said that the art of distillation in Islay heritage was first brought to the island by Irish monks. Being a remote island on the far edge of the Scottish whisky map, this art flourished in the hands of the natives, even when it wasn’t exactly legal. When the law was finally relaxed, it gave whisky makers the chance to set up distilleries completely above board – including the brothers who founded Laphroaig’s distillery on the island’s south coast in 1815. Having shaped Scotch history ever since, becoming the only Scotch awarded a Royal Warrant, Laphroaig continues to create unique releases.

    This whisky invites you in with a floral bouquet of sweet pea and jasmine, layered by underlying notes of burnt caramel alongside Laphroaig’s signature seaweed and campfire smoke. Enjoy neat or over ice.

    FREE DELIVERY

    Standard Delivery - FREE on all orders over £99

    • Unbeatable Value: FREE delivery, 7 days a week (excluding public holidays) on all orders over £99
    • Time to spare? Delivered within 2-7 days by the quickest possible method
    • Special Delivery Requests? Let us know if we need instructions for where to find your house or want us to leave your wine in the shed!
    • Party Time: Add FREE glass and chiller bin hire to your order (we'll even bring the ice!) Simply contact your local store after placing your order online.

    Next or Nominated Day Delivery - FREE on all orders over £200

    • Don't wait in! We'll drop you a text the day of your expected delivery by 4pm and let you know a 2 hour delivery window
    • Need it now? Next or nominated day delivery when you order before the cut-off (excluding public holidays)
    • How? Delivered by our trusted delivery partners
    • Unbeatable range: Next day or nominated day delivery available on every single product
    SHOP
    LOCAL
    Shop Local - Free collection on all orders
    • Shop Local is the quickest way to shop with Majestic
    • You can collect on the same day from any of our 200 stores at your convenience, 7 days a week. Just enter your postcode on the banner above, browse the selection at your closest store, put together your order and pay online by 3pm, and we'll have it ready within four hours
    • When you come in, you can find your new favourite bottle at our tasting counter, hire glasses, flutes and chiller bins free* and pick up some ice. And our friendly, qualified experts will be on hand to help you discover more
    • You can choose to have it delivered by Majestic within 2-7 days for free when you spend over £99. See our delivery page for more information
    • Alternatively, you can shop the full range on the main website and click & collect within 7 days
    NO QUIBBLE GUARANTEE
    The Majestic money back guarantee Your money back if your wine's not delicious - no quibble, no questions asked

    If you receive an unsatisfactory bottle up to the value of £60, we will always replace, refund, or recommend another wine we think you’ll love – and there is no need to return the bottle to us. If you do not enjoy a bottle you ordered, simply get in touch with your local Majestic Wine store, let them know you did not enjoy this wine and our highly knowledgeable staff will be more than happy to replace the wine with something else we think you’ll love or refund the full amount to you.

    Try something new today!

    FREE GLASS HIRE
    Free glass and flute hire*

    Hire glasses when you purchase your beverages from us. Just pay £2 deposit per glass, then return them ready for use for a full refund. £1 handling fee per 12 glasses when hiring 25 or more glasses. See our terms and conditions.
    To request glasses when you order online, simply place your order online, then contact your local store, quoting your order number.

    *Subject to store availability
    FREE CHILLER BINS HIRE
    Majestic offers free chiller bin* loan for customers purchasing wine from us. 

    Our bins hold 18-24 bottles of wine or Champagne or 2-3 cases of lager when filled with ice and water. Drinks will be chilled in 30-45 minutes and will be kept cold for several hours, especially if kept in the shade.
    We can also sell the ice to go in a chiller bin, or have it arrive separately - simply contact your local store after placing your order.

    *Subject to store availability
